question: What radiant form should the world-enchanting goddess assume in her own abode during meditation?
premises: The goddess resides in her own abode
She shines with the radiance of countless suns
She is the enchantress of the world
inference: The practitioner should meditate on the world-enchanting goddess in her own abode as radiant like countless suns
plain_english: One should meditate on the world-enchanting goddess in her own abode, radiant as millions of suns.
